sql: SELECT json_build_object('leads', (SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('id', l.id, 'status', l.status, 'created', l.created_at, 'unit', l.unit, 'campaign', l.campaign_name, 'whatsapp', l.whatsapp)) FROM campaign_leads l WHERE l.company_id = 'a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001' AND l.whatsapp LIKE '%96806890%'), 'midia_vendas2_por_dia', (SELECT json_agg(x ORDER BY x.dia DESC) FROM (SELECT date(m.timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo') AS dia, m.message_type, m.status, count(*) AS n FROM wapi_messages m JOIN wapi_conversations c ON c.id = m.conversation_id JOIN wapi_instances i ON i.id = c.instance_id WHERE i.unit = 'VENDAS 2' AND i.company_id = 'a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001' AND m.from_me AND m.message_type IN ('image','video','document') AND m.timestamp > now() - interval '6 days' GROUP BY 1,2,3) x))
